title: That Brazilian Couple Teaches The Sound of Music’s Laendler Dance - Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors present a cheerful and encouraging teaching style, taking turns explaining and demonstrating steps. They break down the choreography into distinct numbered steps while providing verbal counts and body positioning tips.

lesson_structure.note: The teachers introduce themselves as That Brazilian Couple.
The teachers give background on the Laendler dance from The Sound of Music.
Teaching The Basic step solo style.
Teaching Step 1: Step & stop in partner position.
Teaching Step 2: Down, step, hop solo style.
Teaching Step 3: Under Turn in partner position.
Teaching Step 4: Finger Turn in partner position.

steps_taught.name: The Basic step
steps_taught.description: Bend knee down on the first count and straighten feet on up up.

steps_taught.name: Step 1: Step & stop
steps_taught.description: Stepping and stopping facing each other in partner hold.

steps_taught.name: Step 2: Down, step, hop
steps_taught.description: Step down, step out, and hop.

steps_taught.name: Step 3: Under Turn
steps_taught.description: Going under arms while maintaining hand connection.

steps_taught.name: Step 4: Finger Turn
steps_taught.description: Turning under a finger grip hold with skirt movement.

quotes.text: We're going to start the video by teaching you guys the basic step.
You're going to offer the right hand and you accept with your left hand.
And now we're going to go under ourselves.
You switch a little bit, but never lose the connection.

evidence_segments.observation: Female instructor demonstrates solo basic footwork with bent knee on down and straight legs on up up
Couple demonstrates partner step and stop with alternating left and right lead

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down every footwork pattern into solo practice first before adding the partner connection.
